translations.title: Multivitamin Soft Capsule — Vitamins E and B + Magnesium (no vitamin A, no iron)
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to supply vitamins E, B1, B2 and B6 during physical fatigue, low energy and old age; for neuralgia, muscle pain and joint pain; for angular cheilitis and mouth sores; for beriberi and eye fatigue; to relieve peripheral circulation problems and cold hands and feet; and for muscle cramps caused by magnesium deficiency.
translations.usage: Children aged 12 or older and adults take one capsule twice a day.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you are hypersensitive to soybean oil, soy or peanuts, if the child is under 12 months old, or if you have severe kidney failure. If you are prone to blood clots or have abnormal fat metabolism, consult a pharmacist. This combination does not contain vitamin A or iron.
